# اِغْتَرَفْتَ (iḡtarafta) /iɣ.ta.raf.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِغْتَرَفَ (iḡtarafa)
# اِغْتَرَفْتِ (iḡtarafti) /iɣ.ta.raf.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِغْتَرَفَ (iḡtarafa)
